history.period: About 1200 years old per Wikipedia and local tradition
history.summary: The Arulmigu Periya Mariamman Temple stands near Panneer Selvam Park on Brough Road (Meenakshi Sundaranar Salai), opposite the Erode Corporation building, in the heart of Erode city. Tradition holds it was built by the Kongu Cholas about 1200 years ago. It is worshipped as the head of all Mariammans in the city - the many other Mariamman temples (Karungalpalayam, Nadu, Narayana Valasu, Kumulankuttai, Ellai Mariamman) acknowledge her primacy - and the Devasthanam formally includes the Chinna Mariamman Temple in Periyar Street and the Vaikkal Mariamman Temple at Karaivakkal. The Simha (lion) vahana of Shakti and a thoori (palm-fiber broom) stand majestically at the entrance; the temple car is painted with Shiva and Muruga and designed as if borne by four elephants on four sides. The annual Panguni car festival begins simultaneously at all three temples, and its distinctive feature is that all Mariammans join together from day one with all communities, transcending religion and caste; music, plays, pattimandrams (religious debates), kavi sammelans and bommalattam (doll-play) run through the 20 days, ending with Manjal Neerattu (turmeric-water, likened to Holi) as thousands of women bathe the removed Kambam posts and immerse them in the canal. The sthala tree is the neem tree (per templesofindia.org). HRCE temple website: erodeperiyamariamman.tnhrce.in (per Wikipedia).

name: Periya Mariamman Temple
town_description: Erode is a major city of the Kongu Nadu region on the Kaveri river, known as a textile and turmeric trading hub ('Turmeric City'). The Periya Mariamman Temple sits at its civic heart near Panneer Selvam Park, opposite the Erode Corporation building on Brough Road, surrounded by the city's markets and bus stands.
